nodes.label: The Lach Cylinder Applied (paper)
nodes.rationale: Four movements — reconstruction, complete shape and per-cell definition, electromagnetic mode indices, and the lattice bracket — run reflexively under the very protocols they report, with the session's own failures logged as bounds and its own definition cost computed by the book's grid method.

nodes.label: Reconstruction of Λ against Nineteen Invariants
Two Definitional Defects: the Cap Tuple and the Unstated k ≥ 1
nodes.rationale: The stated cap tuple (3,3,2,3) does not reproduce the object and a required condition k ≥ 1 is nowhere stated — both load-bearing, both located by rebuilding Λ from its published constraints rather than by reading the text.

nodes.label: The Lattice Bracket (bracketing by all lattice covers)
nodes.rationale: Bracketing a level by all of its lattice covers rather than along one channel tightens intervals roughly twofold at ℓ ≤ 2 and two orders of magnitude at ℓ ≥ 3, with perfect separation: 55 admissible cells, 0 violations, against 12 excluded cells, 12 violations.

nodes.label: Law of Realised Closure, Sharpened
nodes.rationale: An open index does not close itself except where the closure operator is realised in the object's own structure; the sharpening distinguishes order-realisation from identity-realisation and conjectures that identity-realisation leaves slack equal to the kernel of the realising identity.

nodes.label: Rectangular and Spherical Cavity Mode Indices
nodes.rationale: The rectangular cavity fails meet-closure for a structural reason predicted in advance; the spherical one is predicted to succeed by a cap-arity criterion and does, on 114,960 pairs without exception — and its cap m′ ≤ 2ℓ′+2 is Λ's own angular-momentum cap without the factor of two, so the connectivity of the constraint graph encodes exchange statistics.

nodes.label: The Principles P1–P21
nodes.rationale: P19 makes completeness strictly stronger than closure — E(X) = 0 says no admitted cell is absent, Q(X) = ∅ says no admitted question is unanswered; P20 makes the language bound whether a question can close at all, which is why documentary novelty claims are structurally unclosable; P21 is used as an instrument, a property failing in one of six languages convicting the expression, not the property.

nodes.label: The Working Protocols B.2.2–B.2.16
nodes.rationale: Admissibility r ≥ 5, census before search, declines recorded with cause, exhaustive verification, two independent routes sharing no step, refusal over silent default, provenance to table and page, commit before you look, compute then write (the one the book records as most often violated in its own production), every failure read as a bound, and the grid.

nodes.label: The Deductive Bracket (1,105 of 1,105 interior cells)
nodes.rationale: A fit says where a level probably is; the bracket says where it cannot fail to be. Monotonicity of T = I − E in n makes any interior member's containment a deduction rather than a prediction.

nodes.label: Admissibility by Strict Monotonicity, Not Sign Constancy
nodes.rationale: A falsification campaign on Be II failed to produce a violation and in failing corrected the framework: a positive-to-negative defect crossing preserves order and is harmless, only a negative-to-positive crossing inverts it — collapsing three admissibility tests to two, and spending the prediction budget cell for cell as E(X) fell from 5 to 3.
